$comment: Machine-readable record of how each upstream commit since the baseline was treated in this fork. docs/upstream-sync.md renders its Sync point section from this file; scripts/check-upstream-ports.mjs fails when the two drift, when a commit is unclassified, or when a decline rests on a host-capability claim the host contradicts.

upstreamRef.note: Full sha is re-derived by the check from the remote ref; recorded here for humans.

entries.subject: fix(codex): lower a saved "ultra" reasoning effort to "max" on the wire
entries.reason: Codex answered HTTP 400 for a literal ultra; we sent the stored preference unchanged.

entries.subject: ci: print OIDC claims and token-exchange result before publishing
entries.reason: Fork's release.yml already owns publishing; this debug aid targets their workflow.

entries.subject: ci: let npm publish authenticate via OIDC
entries.reason: Fork already publishes through OIDC trusted publishing since v0.1.0.

entries.subject: chore: release v0.9.8
entries.reason: Upstream release line; the fork versions independently (see docs/compatibility.md).

entries.subject: ci: publish releases from GitHub Actions with npm provenance
entries.reason: Fork shipped its own release.yml with the same mechanism; see docs/compatibility.md step 5.

entries.subject: fix(claude): offload the oldest images before a request exceeds the 32MB limit (#136)
entries.reason: Long sessions accumulated inline images until every turn and compaction failed HTTP 413. The host executor that performs the offload ships in dsh-base on every version in our window; the plugin only asks, never trims history itself.

entries.subject: feat(codex): add guarded manual reset redemption
entries.reason: New capability; reimplemented on our rewritten subscription section, with the guard re-keyed on the resolved account.

entries.subject: fix(settings): polish reset disclosure and remove server diagnostic
entries.reason: Part of the reset-credit series; only the UI half applies to us.

entries.subject: fix(settings): use a subtle chevron for reset credits
entries.reason: Part of the reset-credit series.

entries.subject: feat(settings): make Codex reset credits collapsible
entries.reason: Part of the reset-credit series.

entries.subject: feat(codex): display available reset credits and expirations
entries.reason: Part of the reset-credit series.

entries.subject: Drop Codex "ultra" from discovered reasoning efforts
entries.reason: Paired with the wire mapping; discovery alone would leave saved ultra reaching the backend.

entries.subject: fix: support DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and harden provider routing
entries.reason: Release mechanics in this commit are not applicable (lockfile and devDependency floor moves). The account-scoped replay and SSE stream-cancellation halves are genuine gaps in our fork and are being ported on their own. Split, not cherry-picked.

entries.subject: docs(claude): qualify cache TTL costs and interoperability
entries.reason: Documents the same TTL setting; travels with the feature.

entries.subject: Admit DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 in peer ranges
entries.reason: Our bounded range >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 already admits it; see docs/compatibility.md.

entries.subject: feat(claude): make the prompt-cache TTL configurable (5m or 1h)
entries.reason: Cost control for cache writes. Default 5m keeps the previous wire bytes unchanged.

entries.subject: perf: serve cached model catalogs and refresh hourly
entries.reason: Changes when the model list refreshes; needs a maintainer decision because it alters freshness semantics on our rewritten catalog path.

entries.subject: fix: apply subscription names to model picker groups
entries.reason: Depends on upstream's displayName field, which our fork's preference validator does not carry. Needs the field decision first.

entries.subject: style: align subscription controls and usage popover with native UI
entries.reason: Restyled on our rewritten components. Deviation: color-scheme is left to the host, because our scoped rules outrank :root and would pin native controls light in a dark theme.

entries.subject: feat: add subscription and model display names
entries.reason: Collides with this fork's own localized plugin naming; needs a maintainer decision before adopting.

entries.subject: chore: release v0.9.6
entries.reason: Upstream release line.

entries.subject: feat(settings): show the CLI version Codex and Claude present
entries.reason: Behaviour ported before this ledger existed. The fork commit is not a descendant of the upstream sha, which is exactly the case this ledger makes visible.
